label: Turn supplier documents into draft vendor bills
authored_by: drafted by the measuring session from the deployer's brief, "an agent that turns incoming supplier documents into draft vendor bills (never posted), with a narrowly scoped integration user (not admin)"; not yet corrected by the deployer
description: Read each supplier document, find the supplier among the ones already in Odoo, and create a draft vendor bill for it, for a person to check and post. Never post a bill, pay anything, email a supplier, create or change a supplier, or schedule anything. A document from a supplier Odoo does not know goes back to a person.

notes.read.file.host: wanted for suppliers, journals, accounts and taxes. The same primitive reaches supplier bank accounts, which the deployer did not ask for; one primitive cannot show the difference, so it is said here
notes.write.file.project: wanted for creating drafts. Editing a draft after a person approved it is the same primitive and Odoo will not separate it from creating; the exercise held it with a broker that applied only approved, hashed operations
notes.send.message.world: refused: suppliers hear from a person
notes.write.file.host: refused: attaching the supplier's document is the one write here that would be welcome, and it rides on the same row as email templates
notes.write.budget.tenant: refused: payments, and AI credits if this were an Odoo AI agent on Enterprise

provenance.note: A starting point in the deployer's words, sorted over the 23 primitives by the measuring session. It is a draft for the people who own the bills, the suppliers and the Odoo database to correct.
